license_and_attribution.license: No item-specific reuse license was identified in the IBGE catalogue record or scanned volume during this review.
license_and_attribution.rights_status: Unresolved; do not treat this as a license determination. The work is an 1870s government publication, while the digital scan and current-hosting terms are separate questions.
license_and_attribution.attribution_statement: Cite the original Recenseamento do Brazil em 1872, volume 10, and the IBGE Biblioteca digital copy.

discovery_evidence.catalog_metadata: The record identifies 12 volumes and explicitly assigns v.10 to Rio de Janeiro, v.5 to Município Neutro; bibliographic year is uncertain [1874?].
discovery_evidence.visual_review: Rendered source page 2 (printed page 1) from the official volume PDF to inspect the table form; no numeric rows were transcribed into this packet.

evaluated_tables.table_family: Quadro geral da população da parochia
evaluated_tables.geographic_unit: Named historical parish (parochia), printed within Provincia do Rio de Janeiro volume 10
evaluated_tables.population_table_note: A separate age table labels present population as população de facto and also shows an absent-population table. Geography and denominator must be taken from each table heading, not inferred from the book title alone.

illustrative_rows.reason: The high-resolution scan is legible visually, but the extracted OCR is materially corrupted in the dense multi-axis numerals. The review deliberately retains no unverified counts. The visible labels are schema evidence only, not observation rows.

methods.retrieval: Downloaded the official IBGE-hosted PDF; recorded exact byte count and SHA-256.
methods.inspection: Used PDF metadata, pdftotext for discovery, and rendered source page 2 for visual review. OCR was not used as a numeric authority.
methods.territorial_scope: Restricted to the volume catalogued as Province of Rio de Janeiro. Município Neutro is a separately catalogued volume (v.5) and is excluded.
methods.uncertainty: No municipality/parish concordance or historical boundary geometry evaluated; the full numeric transcription, denominator reconciliation, enumeration date within 1872, and scan reuse rights remain unresolved.
